تقديرية وفق نظام العمل السعودي، المادتين: Estimated under the Saudi Labor Law, Articles 84 and 85
⚠️ أداة تقديرية غير رسمية بناءً على الما: ⚠️ Unofficial estimate based on Articles 84 and 85 of the Saudi Labor Law. It does not cover disciplinary dismissal (Article 80), which may forfeit the gratuity, or resignation for reasons that exceptionally give the right to the full gratuity (Article 81). Check
نصف شهر أجر عن كل سنة من أول 5 سنوات، وش: Half a month's wage for each year of the first 5 years, and a full month's wage for each year after that, based on the last wage. Fractions of a year are calculated proportionally.
هل المكافأة نفسها بالاستقالة؟: Is the gratuity the same if I resign?
لا. بالاستقالة تطبّق المادة 85: أقل من س: No. In case of resignation, Article 85 applies: less than two years = nothing, 2–5 years = one third, 5–10 years = two thirds, 10 years or more = full.
ماذا لو استقلت قبل سنتين؟: What if I resign before two years?
You are not entitled to any gratuity, according to Article 85.
على الأساسي أم الإجمالي؟: On the basic wage or the total wage?
راجع عقدك — الممارسة قد تختلف بين الشركا: Check your contract — practice may differ between companies as to whether fixed allowances are included.
هل هذه بديل عن تقدير رسمي؟: Is this a substitute for an official estimate?
لا، هذه أداة تقديرية فقط. للحالات المتنا: No, this is an estimation tool only. For disputed cases, consult the labor platform or a specialized lawyer.
